body:
Correction to report ba3ce1e1-34b7-4431-a237-4d7d4d9c8ed7: removing the footer space also removed the section separator. The divider is now restored with compact 8px spacing on both sides after Counters. Description is separated from Counters in either order.

The full gate passes 251 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Release card-layout passes in Chromium and WebKit; 24 geometry cases and both phone arrangements were checked. Rebuilt/restarted the existing manual app: trusted HTTPS/build assets verified, all 39 prior source versions, two pins, preferences and certificate preserved. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-counter-footer-spacing.md#divider-correction. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.
